attackers_goals: Execute tooling, shells, or other malicious commands on the device.
description: An uncommon command was executed. This behavior may indicate an adversary who gained access to the device.
investigative_actions: Confirm whether the command is part of a legitimate change / maintenance activity on this device. Review who initiated the session on the device around the execution time. Check whether the same uncommon command appears on other devices.
